description: Graph-native intrinsic/default-mode control. A continuous NetworkModeState tracks external load, task demand, interoceptive urgency, uncertainty, idle duration, and overlapping external-attention, executive, salience, and default-mode weights. During genuinely low external demand it creates one bounded, interruptible internally generated context from an unresolved goal or consolidated episode. Imagined scenarios and predicted states carry explicit non-observation provenance. Epoch, deadline, budget, cooldown, and cleanup guards prevent fixed-point runaway and unbounded transient growth. Prospective-simulation and episodic-replay SystemTwoTaskSets are graph-held seams for asynchronous cognitive tasks; no host-side cognition is required.

microtheory.name: intrinsic_default_mode_control
microtheory.description: Default-mode cognition is an overlapping, resource-bounded network regime rather than an exclusive switch. It proposes imagined and predicted material from held goals and episodes when the world is quiet, and yields immediately to salient external demand.

rules.name: default_mode_integrate_latest_network_sample
rules.comment: One graph-held sample advances all continuous mode variables once. The weights overlap: this is not a winner-take-all network switch.

rules.name: default_mode_bind_current_belief_to_goal_context
rules.comment: Prospection starts from the newest current perceived belief snapshot. The context retains the explicit source instead of allowing a host-selected implicit world state.

rules.name: default_mode_reconstruct_episode_belief
rules.comment: Episodic default-mode content is reconstructed as remembered support, never relabelled as a current perception.

rules.name: default_mode_request_content_bearing_simulation
rules.comment: The default-mode context authors an inspectable simulation request. The generative world-model seed, rather than the host, expands its action-conditioned content.

rules.name: default_mode_seal_world_model_action_snapshot
rules.comment: Action collection is a separate graph phase so the generative model sees a complete immutable branch set, independent of rule-area evaluation order.
